standard.title: Learning area vocabulary
standard.description: recognise the vocabulary of learning area topics
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can recognise and develop awareness of vocabulary used in familiar contexts related to personal experiences (AC9EFLA08). They have not yet systematically recognised topic-specific vocabulary tied to learning area disciplines, or understood the cultural and contextual dimension of vocabulary such as Acknowledgement of Country.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students recognise vocabulary associated with learning area topics, including topic-specific terms used in classroom discussions and protocols such as Acknowledgement of Country.

nodes.label: Topics have their own words
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can identify that different learning areas use their own topic-specific vocabulary and can name examples from a familiar topic.
nodes.minimum_width: Name at least three topic-specific words from a learning area topic currently studied and explain that these words belong to that topic.
nodes.typical_width: Identify topic-specific vocabulary from at least two different learning area topics, explain that each discipline has words that belong to it, and use those words when discussing the topic.
wider: Compare vocabulary from two different learning area topics and discuss what makes words 'belong' to a particular field
Investigate how some words are used in everyday language and in a technical sense in a learning area (e.g. 'force' in science versus everyday use)
success_criteria: Student names at least three topic-specific words from a current learning area topic
Student explains that these words are associated with that particular topic or subject

nodes.label: Using topic vocabulary in context
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can use appropriate topic-specific vocabulary when discussing a learning area topic.
nodes.minimum_width: Use at least two topic-specific words correctly in a discussion or explanation of a learning area topic.
nodes.typical_width: Use appropriate topic-specific vocabulary when discussing or writing about learning area topics, selecting words that accurately name the concepts or phenomena being described.
wider: Compare how the same topic is discussed using everyday words versus topic-specific vocabulary, and discuss why precision matters
Explore topic vocabulary across multiple learning areas studied this year and build a personal vocabulary collection

response_modes.reason: Recognising topic vocabulary and reliably using it in the right context are distinct competencies. Students need repeated practice using terms in discussion before they become reliably part of active vocabulary.

success_criteria: Student uses at least two topic-specific words correctly in discussion or writing about a learning area topic
Student demonstrates understanding of a term by using it in a meaningful sentence

nodes.label: Cultural and community vocabulary
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can use appropriate vocabulary in cultural and community protocols, including Acknowledgement of Country, and understand these as a specific vocabulary context.
nodes.minimum_width: Use appropriate vocabulary for an Acknowledgement of Country in a relevant school context and explain the purpose of this protocol.
nodes.typical_width: Use appropriate vocabulary for an Acknowledgement of Country and other school community protocols, understanding these as a culturally significant vocabulary context where word choice reflects respect and recognition of Traditional Owners.
wider: Explore the meaning of key terms used in Acknowledgement of Country (e.g. Traditional Owners, Country, Place) and why precise language matters in this context
Investigate how Acknowledgement of Country varies in different school and community settings and discuss why

response_modes.reason: Acknowledgement of Country vocabulary is culturally situated and carries specific meaning that differs from general topic vocabulary. Students need to understand this as a distinct vocabulary register, not just a list of words to memorise.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Exploring the meaning and cultural significance of Acknowledgement of Country vocabulary is genuinely rich — it connects language learning to cultural understanding, community practice and respect for Country in ways that are meaningful for all students.
success_criteria: Student uses appropriate vocabulary for an Acknowledgement of Country in a school context
Student explains, in their own words, what 'Traditional Owners' means in this context
